decisions.reason: As a flagship electrometer tightly aligned with the firm's core dosimetry, instrumentation, and calibration capabilities, it fits very strong absorptive capacity and is highly likely to be retained and incrementally improved.
The CT image quality test phantom builds on the firm's established imaging and QA knowledge, so the firm can readily interpret market feedback and refine it using existing R&D and clinical expertise.

The mammography image quality phantom is more distant from the firm's historical center of gravity, but it is still adjacent enough to medical imaging QA that the firm is likely to keep it while testing whether its knowledge base can be extended successfully.

The full field mammography test phantom is a relatively distant and narrower extension of the portfolio, so withdrawal risk is higher, but the firm will likely give it more time because it can still leverage imaging QA capabilities and support infrastructure.

As a flagship product line in medical imaging QA that builds on existing measurement, software integration, and service strengths, it is strongly supported by the firm's absorptive capacity and strategic direction.
